scope: Historical data-center scenario, selected four-model panel; not the entire original multi-scenario study

judge.primary_input: subject message.content only; separate reasoning archived but not concatenated

budget_proposal.spending_limits: API-side limits per user; do not change account limits
budget_proposal.policy: No local spending stop limit. Preserve no-retry and sample-count guards. No automatic top-up or paid judge fallback.

preflight_after_approval.gate: All six conditions per model must validate before starting full production; no retest of the two completed headline smoke calls.

sample_policy.planned_manifest: One unique model/condition/sample ID for each of 2400 rows, frozen and deterministically shuffled before execution
sample_policy.ambiguous_request: Retain reservation and stop for reconciliation, never silently repurchase
sample_policy.completed_subjects: Immutable; scoring and analysis reuse saved text
sample_policy.failure_denominators: Report planned/attempted/completed/scored/failed/truncated/excluded; no silent replacement or harmless label for failure

per_sample: exact request including roles, prompts, temperature, cap and routing
raw response including separate reasoning and usage
request/generation ID, returned model/provider and finish state
exact judge request and completed response
per_campaign: frozen protocol, 2400-slot manifest and approval record
code/source revisions, uv.lock and prompt hashes
transcripts, aggregate counts, exclusions, SHA-256 index
evidence.secrets: Never export keys, auth headers, OAuth tokens or credential stores; byte-preserving Git attributes and secret screening required

known_deviations: Astra substitutes for Claude 3.7 with different role/sampling controls
